reason: Correct the incomplete earlier shape review and make every source continuation visible.

Restored 10 explicit virgas and corrected three quilisma placements from hwij to hiwj.
Restored the omitted g in initial custó: fh becomes fgh.
Restored 13 explicit virgas and the i quilisma in ut.
Restored g in con(dfd/fgh) and tu(d/fffghFE/...).
Corrected one f to g in the Ser rise and separated Ad, me, Ser and rén into their printed groups.
Restored 19 explicit virgas, including four at the ends of ascending groups.

Removed an extra j from the final saecula figure ijki, which is printed iki.
